on Monday that its subsidiary Sabre Financial Borrower had planned to offer an aggregate principal amount of of $1.1B of senior secured notes.
The notes will be fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the company and certain existing and future foreign subsidiaries, with foreign-guarantor guarantees capped at $400M.
Sabre Financial will use the proceeds to fund a new intercompany loan to Sabre GLBL.
Sabre GLBL plans to use the proceeds to repay its existing intercompany loan at 100% of outstanding principal, plus a make-whole premium and accrued interest.
Sabre Financial plans to use the resulting funds to prepay, redeem, or repurchase certain existing debt, including its 11.125% senior secured notes due in 2029.

title: Sabre announces offering of $1.1B senior secured notes
